comment: The skill manifest, in the shape the agent manifest already has: a static host cannot list a directory, so this file IS the listing for public/skills/. Today the skills are compiled into the build (crates/agent/src/skills.rs holds the include list) rather than fetched, because the fetch adapter and the tool executor live in crates outside this increment; crates/agent/tests/skills.rs asserts that this list and that include list name the same skills, so wiring the fetch later cannot silently disagree with the manifest.
